name: unbound-nil-value-and-var-root
expression: (do (def ^:dynamic frame-snapshot-nil) (binding [frame-snapshot-nil nil] [(nil? frame-snapshot-nil) (identical? frame-snapshot-nil nil) @(var frame-snapshot-nil)]))

name: nested-unbound-binding-restores-selected-value
expression: (do (def ^:dynamic frame-snapshot-nested) (binding [frame-snapshot-nested nil] [(identical? frame-snapshot-nested nil) (binding [frame-snapshot-nested false] [frame-snapshot-nested (identical? frame-snapshot-nested false)]) (identical? frame-snapshot-nested nil)]))

name: throwing-inner-binding-restores-outer-unbound-var
expression: (do (def ^:dynamic frame-snapshot-throw) (binding [frame-snapshot-throw nil] [(try (binding [frame-snapshot-throw false] (throw (ex-info "inner" {:inside true}))) (catch Throwable e (ex-data e))) (identical? frame-snapshot-throw nil)]))

name: unbound-snapshot-precedes-one-initializer-effect
expression: (do (def ^:dynamic frame-snapshot-initializer) (let [effects (atom []) result (binding [frame-snapshot-initializer (do (swap! effects conj :init) nil)] (identical? frame-snapshot-initializer nil))] [result @effects]))
